Menu values and tool scores are fitted predictions. Use the observed evidence, state a testable short hypothesis, and specify edits that match displayed candidate identities on the pinned GFP reference. All eligible candidates are from a fixed menu. Do not estimate or cite measurements for candidates. Keep all text fields concise and evidence-specific.

decision.analyst: Observed O1–O3 have high measured brightness, while O4–O5 are dim; select menu designs containing conservative edits and avoid edits implicated in dim observations.
decision.hypothesis: Among these observations, conservative substitutions can retain high brightness when not paired with disruptive edits; the selected conservative-edit designs should therefore remain brighter than variants carrying disruptive substitutions.
decision.critic: The high measured observations O1–O3 motivate testing conservative substitutions, but they do not establish that these edits cause brightness; their mutation contexts differ. Tool estimates are predictions, not measurements.
decision.selection_rationale: Prioritize C40 and C37, tied for the highest returned estimate (3.614), followed by C47 (3.553), C16 (3.547), and C09 (3.545). This ranking tests the conservative-edit hypothesis, while the narrow estimate differences make the ordering tentative.
